---
title: "1_CFAR"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

To display the CFAR map in a 2D hexbin.

Note: the data files required to run this analysis are too large to store in GitHub.
In order to generate them, please run 1A_SpatialDataProcessing.Rmd.

```{r libraries}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(hexbin)
library(here)
library(scico)
```

Load data.

```{r}
# Load hex grid
hex_path <- here("Supplementary_Material/Data/HexData/Processed/hex.rds")

if (!file.exists(hex_path)) {
  stop("Missing hex data.")
} else {
  hex <- readRDS(hex_path)
}

# Load species ranges
ranges_path <- here("Supplementary_Material/Data/HexData/Processed/ranges.rds")

if (!file.exists(ranges_path)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("chondrichthyes.species.ranges", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Missing ranges.rds and chondrichthyes.species.ranges package.")
  }
  ranges <- chondrichthyes.species.ranges::get_ranges() %>%
    st_transform(st_crs(hex))
  saveRDS(ranges, ranges_path)
} else {
  ranges <- readRDS(ranges_path)
}

# Load CFAR data
cfar_data <- read.csv("Data/SharkData/TraitData.csv",
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Genus_species = str_replace_all(Genus_species, "_", " ")) %>%
  select(sci_name = Genus_species, CFAR)
```

```{r}
# Join ranges and CFAR data
ranges <- left_join(ranges, cfar_data, by = "sci_name")
```

```{r}
# Intersect species ranges and hex cells
range_intersect_hex <- st_intersects(ranges, hex)

range_hex_df <- tibble(
  species_index = rep(seq_along(range_intersect_hex), lengths(range_intersect_hex)),
  hex_index = unlist(range_intersect_hex)
) %>%
  mutate(CFAR = ranges$CFAR[species_index])
```

```{r}
# Calculate mean and variance per cell
hex_cfar_stats <- range_hex_df %>%
  group_by(hex_index) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_CFAR = mean(CFAR, na.rm = TRUE),
    var_CFAR = var(CFAR, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hex$mean_CFAR <- NA_real_
hex$var_CFAR <- NA_real_
hex$mean_CFAR[hex_cfar_stats$hex_index] <- hex_cfar_stats$mean_CFAR
hex$var_CFAR[hex_cfar_stats$hex_index] <- hex_cfar_stats$var_CFAR
```

```{r}
# Extract lat/lon from hex cells
hex_ll <- hex %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  )
```

```{r}
# Prepare plotting data
plot_df <- hex_ll %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(is.finite(lat), is.finite(mean_CFAR), is.finite(var_CFAR)) %>%
  mutate(lat_bin = floor(lat / 5) * 5)

# Compute latitude-bin centiles for mean CFAR
mean_centiles <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(lat_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    lat_mid = lat_bin + 2.5,
    c10 = quantile(mean_CFAR, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    c50 = quantile(mean_CFAR, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    c90 = quantile(mean_CFAR, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compute latitude-bin centiles for variance CFAR
var_centiles <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(lat_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    lat_mid = lat_bin + 2.5,
    c10 = quantile(var_CFAR, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    c50 = quantile(var_CFAR, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    c90 = quantile(var_CFAR, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Hex bin plots.

```{r}
# Mean plot
mean_hex_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lat, y = mean_CFAR)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 35) +
  scale_fill_scico(palette = "navia", name = "Number of Cells", direction = -1) +
  geom_smooth(data = mean_centiles, aes(x = lat_mid, y = c90),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "#0d00a4",
              linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(data = mean_centiles, aes(x = lat_mid, y = c50),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "#0d00a4",
              linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(data = mean_centiles, aes(x = lat_mid, y = c10),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "#0d00a4",
              linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-90, 90)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-90, -60, -30, 0, 30, 60, 90),
                     labels = c("90°S", "60°S", "30°S", "0°", "30°N", "60°N", "90°N")) +
  labs(title = "A",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Mean CFAR") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.1, 0.8),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "transparent"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

mean_hex_plot
```

```{r}
# Variation plot
var_hex_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = lat, y = var_CFAR)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 35) +
  scale_fill_scico(palette = "acton", name = "Number of Cells", direction = -1) +
  geom_smooth(data = var_centiles, aes(x = lat_mid, y = c90),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "#3c096c",
              linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(data = var_centiles, aes(x = lat_mid, y = c50),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "#3c096c",
              linewidth = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(data = var_centiles, aes(x = lat_mid, y = c10),
              method = "loess", span = 0.4, se = FALSE, color = "#3c096c",
              linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-90, 90)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-90, -60, -30, 0, 30, 60, 90),
                     labels = c("90°S", "60°S", "30°S", "0°", "30°N", "60°N", "90°N")) +
  labs(title = "B",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Variation in CFAR") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.1, 0.8),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "transparent"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

var_hex_plot
```

```{r}
FigureS1 <- arrangeGrob(
  mean_hex_plot,
  var_hex_plot,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1)
)

ggsave("Supplementary_Material/Results/FigS1.tiff", FigureS1, 
       units = "px",
       device = "tiff",
       width = 1600, height = 1400, dpi = 300)
```
